repo: gsd-core's plan-phase workflow enforces a Step 0 guardrail: do not create, rename, or switch git branches during plan-phase — planning stays on whatever branch is already checked out.
Phase 73's init-detected phase_slug (shared-write-navigation-correctness-web) matches the previously created branch feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web, confirming branch/phase alignment.
Phase 73 has no declared requirement-IDs; the plan works directly from 7 success criteria instead.
workflow: gsd-plan-phase's default flow is Research → Plan → Verify → Done, with modifiers (--research, --skip-research, --gaps, --view) to control whether/how the research step runs.

Before spawning planning/research agents, the orchestrator locks in genuinely ambiguous scope decisions (e.g., SC4 interpretation, research-first vs skip) into a CONTEXT.md file so downstream agents inherit consistent decisions, then commits that file before proceeding.
